title: Breaking field removal without version bump or deprecation
expected_feedback: Standard (S5, nature [P] — §8.1: FAIL regardless of triggers): removing the response field 'phone' is a breaking change — partner integrations reading it now get null/undefined. Shipped with no version bump and no deprecation signal. Required: (1) announce deprecation with a correctly typed Deprecation header — RFC 9745 requires a Structured Field Date such as Deprecation: @1688169599, not the pre-standard Deprecation: true — plus an optional Sunset header in RFC 8594 HTTP-date form whose date is not earlier than the deprecation date; (2) a migration guide reachable via Link; rel="deprecation"; (3) direct notification of the identified partners, because headers are not a notification; (4) a version bump or an additive replacement field. The window length is contextual [C]: size it from partner release cadence and any contractual notice period. Six months is a reasonable starting default for a public API with unreachable consumers — quote it as a default to negotiate, not as a rule.
violated_rule: Every change classified breaking or non-breaking
